svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(219, 234, 254), rgb(26, 39, 56)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(37, 99, 235), rgb(105, 158, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 148px; height: 1px; padding-top: 56px; margin-left: 2px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #1d4ed8;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1d4ed8, #81abff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; color: light-dark(rgb(29, 78, 216), rgb(129, 171, 255)); font-weight: bold; margin-top: 4px;
font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; color: light-dark(rgb(71, 85, 105), rgb(155, 167, 184)); margin-top: 1px;
font-size: 10px; font-weight: normal; color: light-dark(rgb(100, 116, 139), rgb(126, 140, 159)); margin-top: 3px;
